input.manifest_yaml:
version: '1'
name: show-isolation-plan-none
filesystem:
  read:
  - dataset.json
  - validator.py
  write:
  - reports/result.json
execution:
  command:
  - /bin/true
datasets:
- dataset.json
coverage_sources:
- validator.py

cases.predicate: contains(.plan, 'Isolation: none') AND contains(.plan, 'Filesystem enforcement: none (host access is unrestricted)') AND contains(.plan, 'dataset.json (file)') AND contains(.plan, 'reports/result.json (file)')

input.manifest_yaml:

name: show-isolation-plan-landlock

  - dataset.json
  - validator.py
  write:
  - reports

coverage_sources:

cases.predicate: contains(.plan, 'Isolation: landlock') AND contains(.plan, 'Contract read-only paths:') AND contains(.plan, 'Contract writable paths:')

contains(.plan, 'Isolation: tempdir') AND contains(.plan, 'Contract read-only paths:') AND contains(.plan, '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt') AND contains(.plan, 'Command argv: ["/bin/true"]') AND contains(.plan, 'Plan diagnostics') AND contains(.plan, 'outside the staged source root')
contains(.plan, 'Isolation: landlock') AND contains(.plan, 'Command argv: ["/bin/true"]') AND contains(.plan, 'Runtime plan: unavailable') AND contains(.plan, 'Plan diagnostics')
contains(.plan, 'Contract left:') AND contains(.plan, 'Contract right:') AND contains(.plan, 'Contract shared:')
contains(.plan, 'Contract read-only paths:') AND contains(.plan, 'nested contract') AND contains(.plan, 'could not be loaded') AND contains(.plan, 'Plan diagnostics')
